authorization: The user explicitly requested continuation on 2026-10-28 after the previous resource stop. This dated addendum makes that resumed attempt finite; it does not silently reinterpret the original two-gate budget.

data_state.basis: Root's preserved run history reports no S1 measurements. Verify the remote stage ledgers before launching this resumed attempt; stop for review if primary data exist outside this stated history.
data_state.previous_health_1: Interrupted by a foreign compute process; retained rows are engineering/calibration evidence only.
data_state.previous_health_2: Reported complete with 30 fresh processes and a passing gate; preserve its original result and verify its archived guard/measurement evidence before reuse of provenance.
data_state.previous_semantics_start: Guard rejected the quiet-start window with active_run=null; zero semantic-probe child processes were launched. This is a resource admission refusal, not a numerical or semantic failure.
data_state.primary_effect_policy: No old pilot, health, calibration, semantic, instrumentation-equivalence or cost-smoke timing becomes H1/H2 primary effect evidence.

preserved_history.policy: Retain all previous records, result directories, launch/status files and incident logs. Do not overwrite an old gate, relabel the old second/final gate, or combine health prefixes from different attempts.

resource_resume.required_before_research: Reacquire 30 uninterrupted quiet seconds on the frozen UUID, then pass one complete fresh health gate before any new S0 GPU validation or S1 measurement.
resource_resume.device_migration: No substitution of another GPU within this addendum. A different physical GPU would require a separately documented device amendment before collecting primary data.
resource_resume.stage_start_resource_refusal_definition: An admission guard identifies foreign compute before any child process for that stage or health attempt starts. Preserve the incident and zero-launch count, increment the resumed session's resource-refusal counter, and do not count it as a started health gate, candidate numerical failure or screen attempt.
resource_resume.refusal_exhaustion: The third such refusal ends this resumed session as resource-unavailable; no indefinite admission polling or repeated stage launches.
resource_resume.health_started_definition: A new health gate consumes one gate from the new budget as soon as its first benchmark child launches. A partial gate consumes that slot; never splice its rows into a later gate.

health_protocol.r_provenance: Reuse only the exact guard-audited calibration rows and hashes in recovery_health_attempt2.json, on the same device and measurement binary. Preserve raw-interval adequacy flags; do not recalibrate from health ratios or candidate performance.
health_protocol.criteria: Unchanged frozen health criteria: every numerical and guard check passes; each workload geometric-mean default/replica ratio is within 2% of one; every individual paired ratio is within 5%; no greater-than-5% early/late drift; default/replica source and compiler-input fingerprints agree.
health_protocol.outputs: Use new append-only resume_20261028 gate/result directories with launch counters, binary/source hashes, frozen R hashes, before/during/after guard records and explicit stage admission versus child-launch state.

resource_resume.retry_eligibility: Only an externally caused foreign-compute interruption may consume the remaining new health gate after another clean 30-second admission. A health numerical, fingerprint, ratio, drift or instrumentation-quality failure ends the resumed session immediately, even if a gate remains.
resource_resume.later_competition: Preserve and stop the affected stage. Resume only after a fresh complete health gate using a remaining slot in this same two-gate budget. No remaining slot means report resource-interrupted/incomplete; the user continuation request is not an unlimited renewal.
resource_resume.noninterference: Do not terminate, signal, reprioritize or change another user's GPU process. Root alone schedules this study's remote GPU jobs.

source_and_measurement_integrity.required: Verify upstream source and generated-header provenance and both original/instrumented executable hashes before reuse. Runner-only fixes may implement the frozen protocol if separately recorded and tested; a changed measurement binary requires an explicit provenance review and the relevant S0/A1 checks before primary collection.

research_protocol_unchanged: 36 frozen workloads and 26 frozen requests; 936 nominal S1 attempts

S1 winner/alternative/global selection; three independent S2 confirmation rounds

H1/H2/H3 are primary; H4 remains auxiliary under its existing coverage and leakage rules

reporting: Report the original two health attempts and the separately authorized resumed-session gates/admission refusals with their own status. The changed budget concerns resource recovery only and cannot erase negative quality evidence or enlarge the research effect dataset.
